stories.title: 'Trouble in Toyland 2026': What Every COS Parent Should Know Before Holiday Shopping

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
U.S. PIRG's Trouble in Toyland 2026 report flags AI toys as a holiday hazard. Researchers found guardrails weakened over extended conversations — one toy produced sexually explicit content. Know before you buy.
#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Nearly 500,000 squishy toys recalled or flagged in the past year — burns from the heated squishy trend are real. PIRG's 2026 report also warns parents about counterfeits from unfamiliar online sellers.
#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

stories.title: CPSC Recalls Qpancy Children's Pajamas Over Burn Hazard — Check Before the Holiday Season

x_posts.text:
CPSC recall #27-094: ~1,309 Qpancy children's pajamas sold on Amazon fail flammability standards — risk of serious burns or death. Stop use immediately and contact Qpancy for a full refund.
#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
With holiday pajama shopping season here: check the tags. Children's sleepwear must be labeled "flame resistant" or "snug-fitting." The Qpancy recall (#27-094) is a reminder to check what your kids wear to bed.
#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
